mechanism: Atomoxetine is a CYP2D6 substrate and chloroquine is a CYP2D6 inhibitor, potentially increasing atomoxetine concentrations; both drugs also have cardiac effects including QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for atomoxetine toxicity symptoms (tremor, tachycardia, hypertension); consider ECG monitoring for QT interval; dose adjustment of atomoxetine may be necessary if used concurrently.
